applicability: source partitions supported by the pinned Joern frontend

container_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the container (Joern CPG export).
container_timeout_seconds.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_memory_bytes.description: Memory limit for the container (Joern CPG export).
container_memory_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_cpu_millis.description: CPU quota (1000 = one core) (Joern CPG export).
container_cpu_millis.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_pids.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_tmpfs_bytes.description: Size of the in-memory /tmp (Joern CPG export).
container_tmpfs_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_stdout_limit_bytes.description: Captured stdout; beyond this the log is truncated (Joern CPG export).
container_stdout_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_stderr_limit_bytes.description: Captured stderr; beyond this the log is truncated (Joern CPG export).
container_stderr_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

cpg_input_bytes_logged.description: Former cap on Joern raw JSONL size; now logged.

cpg_records_logged.description: Former cap on CPG records; now logged.

field_chars_max.description: Longest field kept per CPG record.

search_chars_max.description: Longest search text per CPG record and query.

citation_lines_max.description: Most context lines when dereferencing a CPG locator.
